Name: Slimedew Rancher
Author: StormDrakon
Description:
[color=#ff7700][size=5][b][center]Slimedew Rancher[/center][/b][/size][/color][center][color=#ff7700][color=#ffffff][u]-For Stardew 1.6 use with Content Patcher-[/u][/color][/color][/center][left]
[/left][center]﻿[/center] This mod adds ten of the slimes from Slime Rancher to Stardew Valley! Currently added are pink, tabby, phosphor, honey, puddle, fire, crystal, mosaic, radioactive, and the quantum slime.

If slime rancher is one of your comfort games like it is mine I hope you enjoy this mod! I wanted to see cute slimes in my other favorite comfort game, stardew valley, and so modded them over. Collect all the plorts and sell them for money or you can use them for various buffs! (You need to milk the slimes to get the plorts, sorry, its weird but i don't know how to mod custom items to harvest custom items.)



[u]Installation Guide for Content Patcher for Stardew 1.6:[/u]

[b] ﻿1.[/b] Install SMAPI and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
﻿[b]2.[/b] Run the game at least once to make sure there are no existing problems
﻿[b]3.[/b] Download the Slimedew Rancher file and drag and drop the entire unzipped [CP] Slimedew Rancher folder from the download into ﻿your Stardew Valley\Mods


This is not a replacer mod, this will add new animals to Marnies ranch. They will appear in the buy animals option at Marnies ranch. Some slimes require a Big or Deluxe barn and will not appear until you have the upgrades!

Downloads.Description:
Use with Content Patcher!

Adds 10 slimes from slime rancher as new buyable animals from Marnies Ranch! Use a milk pail to gether the slime plorts.
